0.0.105latest, 2026-11-02

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.105-preAn activity clockLatest

    • The top-right indicator now runs a ten-minute clock. It says Working with a short note while the team is active, switches to Offline and Not being worked on after ten quiet minutes, and always shows a ticking "Developer last active" time.
    • A lost internet connection shows separately as No connection.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.104-preThe dev log updates itself

    • New versions now pop into an open dev log within about a minute, with a toast, an updated counter and gauge, and no reload.
    • The top-right indicator shows your connection (Offline or Reconnecting), recent activity, and a "Working" label with a short note while the team is on something.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.103-preClearer working principles

    • The project's working rules now include four short principles for careful, minimal and checkable changes, adapted from a public guideline set.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.102-preMore polish for the dev log

    • Clips and pictures open in an animated viewer, and cards pop into place when you search or filter.
    • Every version has a Copy link button, and opening a version by its link flashes it. A back-to-top button, press-feedback on the filter buttons and a "/" key that jumps to search were added.
    • The title, text and gauge ease in when the page opens, and the gauge needle idles.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.101-preDev log on the website, by link only

    • The dev log is on the website again, with no button. It opens only from its own address, so only people given the link can find it.
    • The travelling marker on the road now stays on the road line and no longer runs over any text.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.100-preA redesigned dev log

    • The dev log now has an instrument cluster with a rolling version counter and a gauge, a road with a marker that travels as you scroll, and cards that glide in.
    • Search, a pictures-and-clips filter and a milestones filter find any version at once. Clips and pictures open full size.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.99-preThe dev log goes private

    • The dev log now lives behind a private link shared by the team, not on the public website, with an entry for every version.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.98-preA reusable code check

    • A code check that catches typing and syntax mistakes in the test scripts before they reach the game engine is now part of the project.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.97-preLeaning into turns

    • An optional lean makes the character tilt into turns, so turning looks less stiff. Off until the owner tries it.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.96-preWhat we learned, written down

    • New pages gather what was found out so far and a plain how-to for the engine, so nothing learned is lost.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.95-preDev log for friends

    • A small button on the website opens this dev log: every version so far, newest first, with pictures and clips on the version they were made in.
    • The team now writes down lessons from every tricky fix, plus a findings page and an engine how-to, so the same mistake is not made twice.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.94-preWalk baseline locked in

    • The animated walk is confirmed as the base for the character: clean, upright and without sliding.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.93-preFeet on the ground

    • A live setting lifts the character a little, so the soles stop sinking into the floor.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.92-preFlatter feet

    • While a foot is planted it now turns flat against the ground, so the toes stop pointing up.

entries.label: Mon 02 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.91-preThe walk stops sliding

    • The walking speed now comes from the walk animation itself, so the feet match the ground instead of skating.
    • The character no longer hovers above the floor.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.90-preFirst animated walkMilestone

    • The character plays a real walking animation on the test map, moved with the keyboard.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.89-preClearer test messages

    • Fixed a message that vanished, so the test screen now says whether the animations are running.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.88-preShow and hide the bodies

    • New switches show or hide the real body and its hidden animation copy while testing.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.87-preTelling us why

    • The test screen now explains when animations are off: missing clips, or a character not set up for them.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.86-preAnimation first, physics for hitsMilestone

    • Direction change: the character walks with animation, and the physical body takes over only for hits and falls, then hands back. The fully physical walk stays as a later goal.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.85-preA steadier pose

    • Standing still now holds one clean pose instead of walking on the spot.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.84-preAnimation and physics stop fighting

    • The animation system is switched off while the physical body is in control, which stops the body from collapsing.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.83-preAnimation clips can drive the body

    • The hidden copy of the character can now play ready-made animation clips, and the physical body follows it. A temporary test clip is used.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.82-preA gentler push

    • The physical walk pulled the body forward too hard and tipped it. The push is now much weaker and corrected so the body stays upright.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.81-preSeeing the legs lag

    • Test tools show how far each foot is from where it should be, to find why the legs trailed behind.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.80-preLegs that step

    • A hidden copy of the character is posed by code: each foot plants, lifts and steps to a new spot, and the physical legs copy it.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.79-preLess swimming

    • The walking push is spread over the whole body, so it no longer tips forward or drags the limbs.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.78-preFirst physical walk

    • The physical body can be steered with the keyboard, turns to face its direction and swings its legs.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.77-preStanding and hits confirmed

    • Tests on the real character confirm the body stands, reacts to a hit and recovers.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.76-preFaster test updates

    • One command now brings the latest test scripts to the developer's computer.

entries.label: Sun 01 Nov 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.75-preFixing the hover

    • Settings added to bring the feet down onto the ground.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.74-preStanding without sliding

    • The physical body now stays where it stands instead of drifting, and the feet grip the ground.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.73-preA physical body on a real character

    • The physical body is built at run time on the bought stand-in character: bones become joined parts, with motors that hold the pose, balance help and hit reactions.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.72-preSmoother test camera

    • The test camera ignores the character itself and eases in and out, so it no longer jumps while walking.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.71-preFinding the ground

    • The test bench places the character on the map even when it is set up away from it.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.70-preA walking character on the test mapMilestone

    • Press Play on the prototype map and a character appears that can walk, run, jump and be viewed with a camera.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.69-preRagdoll and frozen-door experiment

    • A throwaway experiment tests a physical body pulling a door open, including a door that has frozen shut.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.68-preAll automatic checks green

    • The first full set of automatic checks passed inside the game engine.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.67-preVehicle damage check fixed

    • A set-up problem in vehicle damage was fixed. It had made one check fail.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.66-preTemporary art picks

    • Temporary stand-in picks recorded for characters and weapons. Nothing final; the team's own art is the goal.

entries.label: Sat 31 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.65-preReactive body ideas

    • New design notes: spoken-word gestures, curling up when hit, physically opening doors, and doors that freeze shut in bad weather.

entries.label: Thu 29 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.64-preFirst run inside the engineMilestone

    • The project ran for the first time inside the game engine. Almost all automatic checks passed.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.63-preSetup notes corrected

    • Setup guidance was corrected after a check of the project files.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.62-preProject front page

    • The project's front page was rewritten with the current status, highlights and plans.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.61-preSound plans

    • The sound design now names its reference videos and plans war sounds, falling debris and crash reactions.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.60-preCraters stay

    • Shell craters remain on the ground after the player leaves a war zone.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.59-preArtillery rules

    • Artillery is a war-zone hazard. The distant shot is the warning. A direct hit ends the vehicle's run.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.58-preWar sound and crash feel

    • New design section on war sounds and how crashes should feel from the driver's seat.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.57-preTruck parts and character tools

    • Trucks gain mount points for parts, with rules for what fits where. Early character set-up tools were added.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.56-preClothing and character creation rules

    • Clothing now has layers and warmth rules, and character creation has rules for looks and names.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.55-preCharacters and bought assets plan

    • A plan for characters, clothing, trucks and bought assets, plus a check for character models.

entries.label: Wed 28 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.54-preSetting wording

    • The setting is now described as a country in conflict.

entries.label: Tue 27 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.53-prePlayer guide on the website

    • The website now shows the player guide, and the welcome page tells the war premise.

entries.label: Tue 27 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.52-preA class renamed

    • The Heavy Cargo Operator is now the Heavy Ordnance Operator.

entries.label: Tue 27 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.51-preWhere the campaign ends

    • The campaign ends at the front line of the fifth region. Other regions arrive as later updates.

entries.label: Tue 27 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.50-preStory premise

    • The setting is a country in conflict, and your crew works for its national recovery task force. The campaign and side quests are written into the design.

entries.label: Tue 27 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.49-preIntro sequence for the main menu

    • The main menu opens with a short intro: a fence smash, a freeze, a launch and a roll.

entries.label: Tue 27 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.48-preNotes for the home setup

    • Hand-over notes for continuing the work on the lead's own computer.

entries.label: Tue 27 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.47-preHelpers that keep the design in step

    • Two project helpers were added: one keeps the design document up to date, one checks work independently.

entries.label: Tue 27 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.46-preLinux setup progress

    • Notes on getting the engine running on the lead's Linux computer.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.45-preEmployer voice lines

    • Planned voice lines for each employer: first contact, asking, refusing, accepting, welcoming and saying goodbye.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.44-preFace follows voice (planned)

    • Design and tests for a face that follows the player's voice. Opt-in, on the player's own computer only.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.43-preEngine and drivetrain

    • Engine, turbo, clutch, gearbox and driveshaft, plus engine heat, coolant and radiator behaviour.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.42-prePlayer guide system

    • One source for the player guide, ready for the website, in-game help and a wiki.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.41-preGame internals and saves

    • A plan and tests for the game's internals, plus the data that gets saved.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.40-preRegion recipes

    • Each region now has a recipe for lakes, forests, ground and road wear.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.39-preRegion names

    • The six regions have working made-up names.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.38-preMods and generated land

    • Mods can change game data, with an example mod and checks. Land is now generated from the campaign's seed.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.37-preTires that squash

    • Tires squash and bulge with pressure and load, and sink in soft ground. Looks only.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.36-preWho can join

    • Sessions are Solo, Friends only or Invite only. There is no open level.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.35-preKarma and second chances

    • The karma scale is now centred on neutral and shows as icons only. Players can ask for another chance after a reset.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.34-preThe Sim and water

    • Cheating is handled through karma. New design sections: the Sim (a creative mode) and how water behaves.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.33-preResearch checked

    • A research result was reviewed. One claim was confirmed and the rest marked unknown.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.32-preData fixes

    • Game data was reshaped so the engine can read it, with more checks.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.31-preText becomes data

    • Place names, loading tips and radio lines drafted by an AI text helper were reviewed and turned into game data.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.30-preDesign review

    • A review of the specs found ten issues and added more messages and tests. Two questions went to the owner.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.29-preSame dice for everyone

    • Contracts are rolled the same way on every computer, so a crew sees the same jobs.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.28-preEasier design document

    • The design document was split into small sections, so it is cheaper and faster to work with.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.27-preOnline design document synced

    • The online copy of the design document was brought in line with the main one.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.26-preDesign document caught up

    • The design document now covers all decisions made so far: platform, karma, insurance, weather, saves and the physical body.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.25-preHonest status

    • The roadmap now opens with a plain summary of what is done and what is not.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.24-preWeather

    • Weather is worked out from the seed and the time, with a forecast, so every player sees the same sky.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.23-preSafer saves

    • Save files can detect damage, upgrade old versions and fall back to a backup. A first threat model was drafted.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.22-preContract risk, insurance and aid

    • Contracts pick their risk level first. Insurance and aid were added to the design.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.21-preCode review fixes

    • Fixes from a review: engine overheating, cab shake and truck set-up.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.20-preMultiplayer and tablet plans

    • Plans for how players stay in sync and for the in-cab tablet.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.19-preRoad events and moderation text

    • Road events, animals and weather notes, plus moderation messages, were added after review.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.18-preKarma maths and automatic checks

    • Karma maths and a daily loss limit were added. The code can now be checked automatically without the game engine.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.17-preTuning and the first truck

    • Tuning notes for the physical body and a plan for the first truck.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.16-prePerformance and karma plan

    • A way to keep the game smooth by lowering physics detail when needed, and a draft of the karma service.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.15-preKarma decision

    • Decision: karma, self-moderation and a public log of kicks and bans.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.14-prePlatform plan

    • Decision: the first release is a Windows build that also runs on Linux through Proton.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.13-preHybrid body plan

    • A plan for a physical body that balances, trips, falls and gets back up.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.12-preMore text content

    • Fifteen employers, region notes and tablet text were merged after review.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.11-preCharacter design

    • Design for the physical body, grip on the wheel, sleep, hunger and stamina, and clothing in the wind.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.10-preEconomy and crew terms

    • Names settled: employers give jobs, the Operations Chief hosts, Operators join. Classes were renamed.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.9-preFirst helper results

    • Voice phrases and employer replies drafted by an AI text helper were reviewed and merged.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.8-prePolicy alignment

    • Third-party credits, a quality page and sources for the audio and voice notes.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.7-preAI use policy

    • The project follows the Hound Protocol policy on AI. No generated art, music, sound or voices.

entries.label: Mon 26 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.6-preHelper workflow

    • A way to hand simple text work to an AI helper and check the results.

entries.label: Sun 25 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.5-preContent data

    • First draft data for surfaces, grip, weather, seasons, regions, items, contracts and the economy.

entries.label: Sun 25 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.4-preAudio choice and data

    • The audio tool was chosen. The first master data table was added, with checks.

entries.label: Sun 25 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.3-preTruck folder and multiplayer model

    • Each truck lives in one folder. Multiplayer is planned so that lag never shows as stutter.

entries.label: Sun 25 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.2-preGroundwork

    • Eight classes for eight crew slots, and the first multiplayer and audio proposals.

entries.label: Sun 25 Oct 2026
entries.html:
• 0.0.1-preThe skeletonMilestone

    • The project's skeleton: rules, checks, the first design document and the plan for the first modules.
